evidence.observedFact: Dino's actively markets weddings, rehearsal dinners, bridal showers, corporate events, sports banquets and carryout catering for groups of 25 or more, with public phone and email contact for inquiries.
The Wickliffe Pine Ridge event operation asks prospects to call or submit a contact form and states that someone from the team will get back to them soon.
Dino's Restaurant & Bar lists current operating hours seven days a week at 1200 E. 305th St. in Wickliffe and promotes catering and banquet halls.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate event-attendee capture, post-event offers and referral workflows that can convert banquet and catering guests into repeat restaurant and catering customers.
Demonstrate automated inquiry acknowledgement and follow-up tracking for event and catering leads.

notes: Observed facts establish active event/catering volume channels and a manual call/form inquiry path. Improved follow-up and retention are hypotheses, not claims of lost revenue.
